page.notes: The text runs on to the next page at "ille-", which is printed as the catchword. The reading "profopolepfiâ" (item 2) is as printed and may be a printing error for "prosopolepsiâ". Line numbers 5 to 35 in the right margin are printed line markers and are given as notes. The "35" is read from a worn mark and may be imprecise.
